title: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Season 2 Enters Rosenheim Arc With New Key Visual
content: HELL MODE: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing Season 2 revealed a new visual for the Rosenheim Arc . The anime is currently ongoing, with HIDIVE exclusively streaming. The new arc began with Episode 7 (Episode 19 overall) today. You can see the new visual below.

title: The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 World Cup Final Member Selection Match Anime Reveals Key Visual, Trailer and 4 New Cast Members
content: The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 WORLD CUP Final Member Selection Match anime has revealed a new key visual and trailer ahead of its September 30 premiere in Japan. Four additional cast members were also announced, all voicing players from Spain’s U-17 team.
author: Anime Corner

title: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman Season 2 Reveals New Characters in Fourth Trailer
content: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman Season 2 anime has released its fourth promotional trailer alongside new voice cast. Two additional characters and their voice actors were revealed, with Kensho Ono joining as Warren Flumvelk and Sumire Uesaka as Shueste Flumvelk.
author: Anime Corner

title: Attack on Titan Returns With a New Look From Original Studio Ahead of a Major Project
content: Even several years after the manga’s ending, barely any series could catch up to the legacy of Attack on Titan . Written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama, the story has received praise for its unique world-building, layers of mysteries, and unexpected plot twists.
author: ComicBook

title: My Hero Academia Creator’s New Manga Fulfills the LGBTQ+ Love Story the Original Only Teased
content: My Hero Academia by Kohei Horikoshi undoubtedly stands as one of the greatest shonen anime series ever made, and likely one of the last of its kind. Ever since the manga ended more than two years ago and the anime recently concluded, there has been an absence that fans can truly feel.
author: ComicBook

title: A Live-Action Anime Adaptation is Tearing Up The Box Office Charts
content: One Piece, Avatar: The Last Airbender, and Yu Yu Hakusho are just three examples of live-action anime adaptations that have been a success. While the stories of Yusuke Urameshi and Aang might be less critically well-received than Luffy’s outing, all three live-action series have new seasons in the works.
author: ComicBook

title: Exclusive: Nakama Press to Release Ace of the Diamond Baseball Manga in Omnibus Volumes
content: Mad Cave Studios' Nakama Press imprint confirmed to ANN on Friday that it will release the Yūji Terajima 's Ace of the Diamond baseball manga in a 3-in-1 omnibus format, starting with the first omnibus volume on March 23, 2027.
author: ANN

title: Netflix’s The One Piece Just Debunked Its Biggest Theory
content: Netflix’s The One Piece anime adaptation is set to become the next major installment in the franchise, and the latest news debunking one popular theory makes the project even more exciting.
author: ComicBook

title: After 20 Year Wait, Simpsons Movie Sequel May Have Just Revealed Perfect Title
content: Shockingly enough, it has almost been twenty years since we last saw the likes of Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa, and Maggie in their own cinematic outing. The Simpsons Movie hit theaters in 2007, giving the Springfield residents an adventure that was simply too big for the small screen.
author: ComicBook
